parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the private access application. The application ID cannot be used together with the private access tag ID for filtering. Sources of the value:
 - [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): Queries private access applications by batch.
 - [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): Creates a private access application.

parameters.name: ApplicationName
parameters.description: The name of the private access application.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page that is returned during paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the private access policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase English letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page that is set during paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: PolicyAction
parameters.description:
The action of the private access policy. Valid values:
- **Block**: Block.
- **Allow**: Allow.

parameters.name: PolicyIds
parameters.description: The collection of private access policy IDs. You can specify up to 100 private access policy IDs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the private access policy. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: TagId
parameters.description:
The ID of the private access tag. The tag ID cannot be used together with the application ID for filtering. Sources of the value:
 - [ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): Queries private access tags by batch.
 - [CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): Creates a private access tag.

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user group. Sources of the value:
- [ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Queries user groups by batch.
- [CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~): Creates a user group.
